doctrine.note: This ranks source acquisition work only. It does not certify runtime, mutate canonical rows, or permit production DB binding.

rankingRules: Prefer verified public bulk/query/download sources over interactive-only search pages.
Prefer counties with payload files or public open-data/download evidence already present.
Prefer smaller or moderate row counts for fast receipt closure.
Penalize demo/sample evidence until recaptured from governed source artifacts.
